# CLI reference

> **Stable since 1.0.** Nothing on this page carries any compatibility guarantee before `1.0.0` ships - every `0.x` release may still change it without notice. See [../compatibility.md](../compatibility.md) (ADR-0017) for what "Stable" means from `1.0.0` on.

Commands and flags below are Stable. The exit-code distinction between `0` (success) and any non-zero value (failure) is Stable; which specific non-zero value a given failure returns is not, and is inconsistent across commands today. Human-readable output (as opposed to a command's own `--json` output, where one exists) is Operational, not Stable, and may be reworded freely.

## `compat`

check the real tool contract against every registered client profile (#133, ADR-0010)

### `lint`

exit 1 if any tool violates a profile's documented limits, 0 otherwise

## `connect`

add the memory-manager server to a client's own config

### `claude-ai`

print the claude.ai custom-connector setup steps

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--url` | yes | — | — | the server's URL, shown in the setup steps |

### `claude-code`

merge the server into Claude Code's own config

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | no | `false` | — | show the diff but write nothing |
| `--inline-token` | no | `false` | — | insert --token-env's current value instead of the usual ${VAR} placeholder (not allowed with --scope project) |
| `--project-dir` | no | `.` | — | project directory --scope project/--with-instructions apply to (default: cwd) |
| `--scope` | no | `"user"` | `user`, `project` | which config to merge into |
| `--token-env VAR` | no | — | — | env var Claude Code reads the bearer token from (default when given bare: MEMORY_MANAGER_TOKEN); omit for OAuth instead of a static token |
| `--transport` | no | `"http"` | `http`, `stdio` | how Claude Code reaches it |
| `--url` | no | — | — | the server's URL (required for --transport http) |
| `--with-instructions` | no | `false` | — | also write the generated .claude/rules/memory-manager.md usage-rules file |

## `doctor`

check every note in the vault against ADR-0005

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--client` | no | — | `claude-ai`, `claude-code` | check this client's own configured connection instead of the vault (--vault/$VAULT_DIR are ignored) |
| `--json` | no | `false` | — | with --client: print the report as JSON instead of text |
| `--project-dir` | no | `.` | — | with --client: project directory its project/local scope config applies to (default: cwd) |
| `--read-only` | no | `false` | — | with --client: skip the memory_write/memory_read/memory_edit/memory_archive round trip, only prove memory_index works |
| `--vault` | no | — | — | path to the vault root (defaults to $VAULT_DIR) |

## `eval`

score retrieval quality against the golden query set

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--baseline` | no | `eval/baseline.json` | — | path to the committed baseline |
| `--golden` | no | `eval/golden.yaml` | — | path to the golden query set |
| `--k` | no | `5` | — | cutoff for recall@k and the search limit |
| `--update-baseline` | no | `false` | — | overwrite --baseline with this run's metrics instead of comparing against it |
| `--vault` | no | `examples/vault` | — | vault to index and query against |

## `export`

export the vault to a tar.gz archive plus a manifest.json

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | no | `false` | — | overwrite --out if it already exists |
| `--include-archive/--no-include-archive` | no | `true` | — | include archived notes (_archive/) in the export (default) / exclude archived notes (_archive/) from the export |
| `--namespace` (repeatable) | no | — | — | limit the export to this namespace (repeatable; default: every namespace) |
| `--out` | no | — | — | output archive path (default 'memory-export-<date>.tar.gz') |
| `--vault` | no | — | — | path to the vault root (defaults to $VAULT_DIR) |

## `hash-password`

hash a password from stdin into an ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH value (ADR-0004 L1)

## `import`

import notes from an external source

### `chatgpt`

import a ChatGPT memory list, or 'bio' calls from a conversations export

Positional arguments:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | yes | — | — | a plain text/Markdown memory list, or (with --from-conversations) a conversations.json export |

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--apply` | no | `false` | — | actually write notes (default is a dry run that writes nothing) |
| `--from-conversations` | no | `false` | — | treat 'file' as a ChatGPT conversations.json export and extract 'bio' memory calls from it, instead of a plain text memory list |
| `--namespace` | yes | — | — | namespace every imported note is filed under |
| `--type` | no | `"user"` | `user`, `feedback`, `project`, `reference`, `fact` | note type for every imported item |

### `claude`

import a Claude memory export (zip, memories JSON, or a plain text list)

Positional arguments:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | yes | — | — | export zip, a memories JSON file, or a plain text/Markdown list |

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--apply` | no | `false` | — | actually write notes (default is a dry run that writes nothing) |
| `--namespace` | yes | — | — | namespace every imported note is filed under |
| `--type` | no | `"user"` | `user`, `feedback`, `project`, `reference`, `fact` | note type for items the export does not map to a fixed type itself (memory_files entries and a plain-text fallback; conversations_memory and project_memories always become 'user'/'project') |

### `markdown`

import a folder of Markdown files

Positional arguments:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | yes | — | — | folder to walk recursively for *.md files |

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--apply` | no | `false` | — | actually write notes (default is a dry run that writes nothing) |
| `--namespace` | yes | — | — | namespace every imported note is filed under |
| `--type` | no | `"reference"` | `user`, `feedback`, `project`, `reference`, `fact` | note type used when a file's frontmatter does not set a valid one |

### `openwebui`

import a user's built-in Open WebUI memories (GET /api/v1/memories/)

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--api-key-env VAR` | no | `"OPENWEBUI_API_KEY"` | — | env var carrying the Open WebUI API key (--url only, default: %(default)s) |
| `--apply` | no | `false` | — | actually write notes (default is a dry run that writes nothing) |
| `--file` | no | — | — | a saved GET /api/v1/memories/ response, instead of a live --url fetch |
| `--namespace` | yes | — | — | namespace every imported note is filed under |
| `--url` | no | — | — | the Open WebUI base URL - its live GET /api/v1/memories/ is fetched |

Mutually exclusive:

- `--file` / `--url`

## `instructions`

render mcp/instructions_generated.py and client instruction files from docs/memory-guide.md

### `generate`

render the generated module and client files from the Markdown source

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | no | `false` | — | additionally render every client's instruction file |
| `--check` | no | `false` | — | exit 1 if any rendered file is stale instead of writing it (no file is touched) |
| `--client` | no | — | `claude-code`, `generic` | additionally render this one client's instruction file |
| `--guide` | no | `docs/memory-guide.md` | — | path to the Markdown source |
| `--out` | no | `src/memory_manager/mcp/instructions_generated.py` | — | path to the generated Python module (unaffected by --client/--all) |

Mutually exclusive:

- `--all` / `--client`

## `migrate`

migrate a Git vault into the Postgres backend (ADR-0007 §6)

### `git-to-postgres`

import a Git vault's notes and history into Postgres

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | no | `false` | — | report the mapping and every note that would be imported, writing nothing |
| `--map <git-ns>=<kind>:<key>[:<alias>]` (repeatable) | no | — | — | repeatable; maps one top-level Git namespace to a Postgres namespace (kind: user\|group\|project\|org); every namespace in the vault needs one |
| `--vault` | no | — | — | path to the vault root (defaults to $VAULT_DIR) |

## `reindex`

bring the Postgres index in step with the vault

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--full` | no | `false` | — | also drop stale rows and recompute every link (full rebuild) |

## `serve`

run the MCP server

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--http` | no | `false` | — | serve over Streamable HTTP, binding to $HOST:$PORT (default 127.0.0.1:8080) |
| `--profile` | no | — | `claude-ai`, `claude-code`, `default` | the client profile (#131, ADR-0010) this stdio connection's single client runs under, instead of the default fallback - --stdio only |
| `--stdio` | no | `false` | — | serve over stdio, for a local Claude Code connection |

## `token`

manage static bearer tokens for the HTTP transport (ADR-0004); with STORAGE_BACKEND=postgres, 'create' additionally requires --owner/--role and --expires-days within STATIC_TOKEN_MAX_DAYS (default 90, ADR-0006 §7, #224)

### `create`

create a token and print it once - it is never shown again

Positional arguments:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | — | — | a unique name identifying the token |

Options:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | no | — | — | free text to tell this token apart from others of the same owner (ADR-0012) |
| `--expires-days` | no | — | — | the token stops verifying this many days from now (default: never expires; required, within STATIC_TOKEN_MAX_DAYS, when STORAGE_BACKEND=postgres) |
| `--kind` | no | `"service"` | `personal`, `service` | one of ('personal', 'service'), default 'service' (ADR-0012, #134); a personal token additionally requires --owner/--role and --expires-days within PERSONAL_TOKEN_MAX_DAYS (default 90) |
| `--namespace` (repeatable) | no | — | — | repeatable; namespace the token may read/write, or omit for every namespace ('*') |
| `--owner` | no | — | — | the token's owner principal (an oid); required together with --role (#115) |
| `--role` (repeatable) | no | — | `Memory.User`, `Memory.Curator`, `Memory.Admin` | repeatable; one of ('Memory.User', 'Memory.Curator', 'Memory.Admin'); required together with --owner |
| `--scope` (repeatable) | yes | — | `memory:read`, `memory:write` | repeatable; one of 'memory:read', 'memory:write' |

### `list`

list every token's metadata (never the token itself)

### `revoke`

revoke a token by name

Positional arguments:

| Flag | Required | Default | Choices | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | — | — | the token's name, as passed to 'token create' |

## `worker`

run periodic singleton jobs (#217) - requires STORAGE_BACKEND=postgres
